Description: Payday/installment lender filed bankruptcy. One of the largest subprime consumer lenders.
Consumer_Impact: Customers lost access to credit lines. Forced to other lenders.
Notes: First cockroach. Payday/installment model under stress from regulatory + credit deterioration.

Description: Banking-as-a-Service platform collapsed. Consumer funds frozen across multiple fintech partners.
Contagion: YES — downstream fintechs lost banking partner. Consumer funds inaccessible.
Consumer_Impact: Thousands of consumers had funds frozen. Multiple fintechs impacted.
Notes: BaaS model vulnerability exposed. Platform risk ≠ bank risk.

Description: Subprime auto fintech failed. Caused downstream BANK CONTAGION — partner banks took losses.
Contagion: YES — BANK CONTAGION. Partner banks absorbed losses from Tricolor portfolio.
Consumer_Impact: Borrowers lost servicer. Loan servicing disrupted.
Notes: CRITICAL: first fintech failure to cause bank contagion. Validates FLOW-PHAN-03.

Description: 30+ DQ rose 5.4%→6.2% in 3 months. Shifted to super-prime (26% of originations). Retreating from subprime.
Contagion: Indirect — subprime consumers lose credit access, pushed to shadow lenders
Consumer_Impact: Subprime borrowers denied. Must turn to BNPL/cash advance instead.
Notes: Not a failure but a TIGHTENING signal. When fintechs retreat, the next layer of shadow credit absorbs the demand.

Description: Securities class action filed post-IPO. Credit loss provisions 0.53%→0.65%. DQ trend outstripping prior year. Sold $26B in loans pre-IPO.
Contagion: Market signal — if Klarna has hidden credit risk, what about smaller BNPL?
Notes: Not a failure but a DISTRESS signal. Pre-IPO portfolio cleanup ($26B sold) suggests known risk.

Description: Q4 2025: net loss $26M; FY2025 overall net loss (vs $21M profit FY2024). Q1 2026 guide $965M missed analyst expectations — stock -15% premarket. Elliott Management $6.5B investment reported.
Contagion: Elliott Management involvement suggests external capital needed — funding stress signal on top of class action
Consumer_Impact: Consumers exposed to stock decline; BNPL credit availability could tighten if Klarna reprices risk
Notes: UPGRADED from DISTRESS-signal to HIGH. Elliott $6.5B parallels regional bank capital raise signals. Q1 2026 guidance miss + annual loss = deteriorating fundamentals narrative.

Description: Under investigation by attorneys for disguised interest rates in subscription fees. Alleged to charge $1-$7 "Instant Float" fees exceeding state usury caps.
Contagion: Indirect — adds to pattern of enforcement wave
Consumer_Impact: Consumers misled about true cost of advances
Notes: Early stage investigation. Pattern: follows Brigit FTC, EarnIn DC AG, DailyPay/MoneyLion NY AG. Cockroach wave count growing.

Description: Under investigation for alleged false "interest-free" advertising while charging advance fees exceeding state usury limits
Notes: Early stage. Adds to enforcement wave pattern.
